questions.question: Who inaugurated India's first lithium-ion battery plant in Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh, in September 2022?

options.text: Rajeev Chandrasekhar, Minister of State for Electronics and Information Technology

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajeev Chandrasekhar, Minister of State for Electronics and Information Technology**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India's first lithium-ion cell manufacturing plant was inaugurated in **Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh**, in September 2022.
 
• **Rajeev Chandrasekhar**, the Minister of State for Electronics and Information Technology, inaugurated this significant facility.
 
• The plant is part of India's push towards promoting **self-reliance in the manufacturing of advanced energy storage systems** and reducing dependency on imports.
 
• The facility was established by **Munoth Industries Limited**, marking a key milestone in India's journey toward building a local ecosystem for lithium-ion battery production.
 
• This project aligns with the government’s **Make in India initiative**, aiming to bolster domestic manufacturing and support the clean energy transition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**

 
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi has been at the forefront of launching several initiatives like **Make in India**, **Atmanirbhar Bharat**, and the **National Electric Mobility Mission Plan** to promote domestic production and clean energy adoption in India.
 
 
 
• **Nirmala Sitharaman, Minister of Finance**
 
 
• Nirmala Sitharaman has played a crucial role in facilitating financial incentives for the electric vehicle (EV) industry, including schemes like **Faster Adoption and Manufacturing of Electric Vehicles (FAME)**.
 
 
 
• **Lithium-Ion Battery Technology**
 
 
• Lithium-ion batteries are rechargeable batteries widely used in electronics, electric vehicles, and renewable energy storage systems due to their **high energy density, lightweight, and long cycle life**.
 
• The production of lithium-ion batteries aligns with India's **National Electric Mobility Mission Plan (NEMMP)** and its commitment to achieving net-zero carbon emissions by 2070.

questions.question: The Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF) provides support for?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Agri-logistics and cold chains**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF) is a financing facility launched by the Government of India in 2020 to strengthen agricultural infrastructure across the country.
 
• It provides medium to long-term debt financing for investment in viable projects for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets.
 
• Key projects funded under the AIF include cold storage, warehousing, sorting & grading units, packhouses, ripening chambers, and other agri-logistics infrastructure.
 
• Through this initiative, farmers and Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) can access loans with interest subvention and credit guarantee support.
 
• The fund also aims to reduce post-harvest losses and improve the efficiency of agricultural supply chains, ensuring better price realization for farmers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Free Fertilizers**
 
 
• The government of India provides subsidies on fertilizers to ensure affordability for farmers, but there is no provision for free fertilizers under the AIF.
 
• Subsidized fertilizers such as urea, DAP, and MOP are made available through schemes like the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) scheme.
 
• The subsidy is directly transferred to fertilizer companies, which reduces the retail price for farmers.
 
 
 
• **Cash Transfers**
 
 
• Cash transfers are direct benefit transfers (DBT) under schemes like PM-KISAN, where eligible farmers receive Rs. 6,000 annually in three installments.
 
• The objective of cash transfers is to provide income support to farmers for agricultural and allied activities.
 
• However, AIF does not involve cash transfers and focuses on infrastructure development.
 
 
 
• **MGNREGA Work**
 
 
• The Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA) provides wage employment for rural households through unskilled manual work.
 
• It aims to enhance livelihood security and create durable assets in rural areas.
 
• While MGNREGA contributes to rural development, it is unrelated to the objectives of AIF, which targets agricultural infrastructure.
 
 
</ul

questions.question: According to the Global Peace Index 2024, which of the following statements correctly reflects global peace trends since 2008?

options.text: All three GPI domains have steadily improved since 2008
The average country score has improved by 4.5% since 2008
Ongoing Conflict and Safety & Security have deteriorated, while Militarisation has improved
The number of countries showing improvement exceeds those showing deterioration

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ongoing Conflict and Safety & Security have deteriorated, while Militarisation has improved**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Global Peace Index (GPI) measures the relative peacefulness of nations using three primary domains: **Ongoing Conflict, Safety & Security, and Militarisation**.
 
• Since 2008, there has been a deterioration in the domains of **Ongoing Conflict** and **Safety & Security** globally, primarily due to an increase in conflicts, violence, and political instability.
 
• However, the **Militarisation** domain has shown improvement, reflecting reduced military expenditure and fewer armed forces in some regions.
 
• Global peace has deteriorated over the years, with 2024 marking the continuation of this trend, driven by factors such as geopolitical tensions, terrorism, and internal conflicts.
 
• The GPI provides a comprehensive overview of global trends in peace, helping policymakers address issues related to conflict and security.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Human Development Report** (UNDP): Measures health, education, and living standards.
 
• **Global Gender Gap Report** (WEF): Ranks countries on gender equality.
 
• **Global Innovation Index** (WIPO): Ranks innovation performance.
 
• **Global Hunger Index** (Concern Worldwide/Welthungerhilfe): Assesses hunger levels.
 
• **World Economic Outlook **(IMF): Forecasts global economic growth, ranking economies.
 
• **Corruption Perceptions Index **(Transparency International): Ranks perceived levels of public sector corruption.

questions.question: Under India's updated State Action Plan on Climate Change (SAPCC) for 2025, which sector received the highest budgetary allocation for climate adaptation?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Agriculture and Water Resources**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Under India's updated State Action Plan on Climate Change (SAPCC) for 2025, the highest budgetary allocation for climate adaptation is given to the **Agriculture and Water Resources** sector.
 
• Agriculture is highly vulnerable to climate change as it depends heavily on climatic conditions such as rainfall, temperature, and seasonal variations.
 
• Water resources management is critical in addressing climate adaptation challenges, such as droughts, floods, and water scarcity exacerbated by climate change.
 
• The allocation aims to enhance irrigation infrastructure, promote sustainable agricultural practices, and improve water conservation efforts to adapt to shifting climate patterns.
 
• This step aligns with India's National Action Plan on Climate Change (NAPCC), which emphasizes resource efficiency, climate resilience, and sustainable development in agriculture and water management.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Renewable Energy**

 
 
• Renewable energy is a key area in mitigating climate change by reducing dependency on fossil fuels and cutting carbon emissions.
 
• India has launched ambitious initiatives, including the National Solar Mission, to transition towards cleaner energy sources.
 
• While important for mitigation, renewable energy is often considered less relevant to immediate adaptation needs, leading to lower allocation under the SAPCC for adaptation purposes.

questions.question: Who broke the 30-year-old Asian Games men's 5,000m meet record in National Open Athletics Championships 2024?

• Gulveer Singh is recognized as one of India's emerging long-distance runners, gaining accolades for his performance in national and international events.

• Breaking a 30-year-old record signifies immense skill, dedication, and training, marking the athlete's place in history.

questions.question: What is the primary function of the NVS-02 satellite launched aboard GSLV-F15?

options.text: It supports meteorological observations for cyclone prediction.
It boosts India's navigation system by offering precise position and timing data.
It conducts deep-space communication with planetary probes.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**It boosts India's navigation system by offering precise position and timing data.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **NVS-02** is part of the NavIC (Navigation with Indian Constellation) satellite system, designed to enhance India's regional navigation capabilities.
 
• The satellite was launched aboard the **GSLV-F15** rocket by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO).
 
• It primarily strengthens India's indigenous satellite-based navigation system by providing accurate positional and timing data.
 
• The satellite ensures improved accuracy for navigation services across India and a region extending up to 1,500 km beyond Indian borders.
 
• **NVS-02** is equipped with advanced rubidium atomic clocks for precise timekeeping, a critical component for navigation systems.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **India's NavIC System**

 
 
• NavIC (Navigation with Indian Constellation) is India's independent regional navigation satellite system developed by ISRO.
 
• It provides accurate position information services to users in India and the surrounding region.
 
• NavIC is comparable to global navigation systems like GPS (USA), GLONASS (Russia), Galileo (EU), and BeiDou (China).
 
• It has applications in terrestrial, aerial, and marine navigation, disaster management, vehicle tracking, and more.

questions.question: The Global Gender Gap Report primarily measures disparities between genders in which key areas?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Politics, Economy, Health, Education**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Global Gender Gap Report, published annually by the **World Economic Forum (WEF)**, measures gender-based disparities in four key areas: **Politics, Economy, Health, and Education**.
 
• It uses a comprehensive framework to evaluate countries on how effectively they are closing gender gaps across these four dimensions.
 
• The report assigns a Gender Gap Index score between 0 (complete inequality) and 1 (complete equality) for each country.
 
• In the political domain, factors such as the percentage of women in parliamentary and ministerial positions are considered.
 
• In the economic domain, the report assesses metrics like workforce participation, wage equality, and leadership roles.
 
• The health dimension examines life expectancy and the gender gap in survival rates, while education focuses on literacy rates and access to education at all levels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **World Economic Forum (WEF) releases several major annual reports, including:** 

 
 
• Global Risks Report: Identifies and analyzes the most critical global risks, drawing from expert surveys.
 
• Future of Jobs Report: Explores how technology and socio-economic shifts are reshaping jobs and required skills.
 
• Global Gender Gap Report: Benchmarks progress on gender equality in four key areas (Economic Participation, Education, Health, Politics).
 
• Top 10 Emerging Technologies: Spotlights technologies with the potential to positively impact society.
 
• Global Cybersecurity Outlook: Examines cybersecurity trends affecting economies and societies.
 
• Global Competitiveness Report: Assesses national competitiveness.

questions.question: Who scored 10 goals for India in their 24-1 victory over the USA to secure a second consecutive Olympic gold medal in hockey?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Roop Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Roop Singh was an Indian field hockey player who played a crucial role in India’s historic Olympic victories in the 1930s.
 
• In the 1932 Summer Olympics held in Los Angeles, India defeated the USA with a record-breaking score of 24-1 in hockey.
 
• Roop Singh scored an incredible 10 goals in this match, showcasing his exceptional skill and earning a place in hockey history.
 
• He was the younger brother of Dhyan Chand, often referred to as the “Wizard of Hockey,” and together they formed a legendary duo in Indian hockey.
 
• Roop Singh’s contribution to the game is celebrated as one of the finest performances in Olympic hockey history.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dhyan Chand:**

 
 
• Dhyan Chand, often referred to as the “Wizard of Hockey,” is widely regarded as one of the greatest hockey players of all time.
 
• He represented India in the Olympics three times (1928, 1932, and 1936) and was instrumental in securing gold medals for the country in all these events.
 
• Dhyan Chand scored multiple goals across these tournaments, earning global fame for his extraordinary dribbling skills and precision.
 
• He received the Padma Bhushan, India’s third-highest civilian award, in 1956 for his contribution to sports.
 
 
 
• **Balbir Singh Sr.:**
 
 
• Balbir Singh Sr. was another legendary hockey player who represented India in the Olympics in later years (1948, 1952, and 1956).
 
• He played a key role in securing three consecutive Olympic gold medals for India.
 
• Balbir Singh Sr. is remembered for scoring five goals in the 1952 Olympic final against the Netherlands, setting a record for the highest number of goals in an Olympic final match.
 
• He was awarded the Padma Shri in recognition of his contributions to Indian hockey.
 
 
 
• **Leslie Claudius:**
 
 
• Leslie Claudius was an Indian hockey player who won three Olympic gold medals (1948, 1952, and 1956) and one silver medal (1960) during his illustrious career.
 
• He was known for his defensive skills and played a key role as a half-back in the Indian hockey team.
 
• Leslie Claudius holds the distinction of being one of the most decorated Olympians in hockey.
 
• He was awarded the Padma Shri for his contributions to the sport of hockey.

questions.question: What initiative was launched in 2021 under India's BRICS Presidency to boost cross-border startup collaboration and innovation?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**BRICS Startup Forum**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **BRICS Startup Forum** was launched in 2021 under India's BRICS Presidency to foster collaboration among startups from BRICS nations.
 
• This initiative aims to promote **cross-border innovation, knowledge sharing, and funding access** for startups within the BRICS economies (Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa).
 
• The forum serves as a platform for startups, investors, and ecosystem enablers to **network and explore partnerships** across diverse sectors.
 
• The **BRICS Startup Forum** aligns with India's vision of fostering entrepreneurship and innovation as a means to drive economic growth and development.
 
• The initiative complements existing BRICS mechanisms, such as the New Development Bank, to enhance economic cooperation and sustainable development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **BRICS Innovation Pact**:
 
 
• Although no formal initiative called the "BRICS Innovation Pact" exists, innovation is a core theme under BRICS cooperation.
 
• BRICS nations have collaborated on several innovation-related initiatives, including technology transfer, R&D partnerships, and skill development programs.
 
 
 
• **BRICS SME Exchange**:
 
 
• This refers to a conceptual framework aimed at improving cooperation between small and medium enterprises (SMEs) across BRICS countries.
 
• The objective is to provide SMEs with opportunities for market access, funding, and knowledge sharing.
 
 
 
• **BRICS Economic Dialogue**:
 
 
• The BRICS Economic Dialogue is a platform that facilitates discussions on economic policies, trade, and investment opportunities among BRICS nations.
 
• It aims to strengthen economic ties and address global economic challenges through collective action.
 
 
</ul

questions.question: Which of the following statements about the 2023 Intercontinental Cup final is correct?

options.text: The final was held in Guwahati where India defeated Lebanon.

questions.question: When did India successfully complete the SpaDeX docking operation?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**16th January 2025**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India successfully completed the SpaDeX (Space Docking Experiment) operation on **16th January 2025**.
 
• The SpaDeX mission is a significant milestone in India’s space exploration capabilities, aimed at demonstrating autonomous docking technology in space.
 
• This operation was conducted by the **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)**, marking a major step forward in India’s ability to support in-orbit servicing and assembly of satellites.
 
• The successful completion of SpaDeX boosts India’s position in the global space industry and enhances the country’s self-reliance in advanced space technologies.
 
• The docking experiment is crucial for future missions, such as the **Indian Human Spaceflight Programme (Gaganyaan)**, and for enabling space station development initiatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Significance of SpaDeX:**

 
 
• SpaDeX enables the demonstration of autonomous docking in orbit, a technology essential for long-term space exploration and maintenance of satellites.
 
• It lays the groundwork for future missions involving refueling, repair, and assembly of spacecraft in orbit.
 
• The mission is aligned with ISRO’s broader goals under the **Gaganyaan programme** and the development of indigenous space station capabilities.

questions.question: Which department launched 'Dak Karmayogi' ?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Department of Posts (DoP)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Department of Posts (DoP) launched 'Dak Karmayogi,' an e-learning platform for its employees aimed at enhancing their skills and productivity.
 
• 'Dak Karmayogi' is a part of the Government of India's Digital India Initiative and aims to upskill the vast workforce of the postal department.
 
• This platform provides training in soft skills, technical knowledge, and leadership development to ensure better service delivery by postal employees.
 
• It is designed to be user-friendly and accessible, allowing employees to learn and upgrade their competencies at their own pace.
 
• With the introduction of 'Dak Karmayogi,' the Department of Posts aims to modernize its workforce and improve citizen-centric services across the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of Civil Aviation (MoCA):**

 
 
• This Ministry is responsible for the formulation of national policies and programs for the development and regulation of the Civil Aviation sector.
 
• It oversees airport infrastructure development, air navigation services, and airline operations across India.
 
• Key initiatives under MoCA include the UDAAN (Ude Desh ka Aam Nagrik) scheme, which aims to enhance regional air connectivity.
 
 
 
• **Department of Fertilizers (DoF):**
 
 
• The Department of Fertilizers operates under the Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers, focusing on the production and distribution of fertilizers across India.
 
• It ensures the availability of fertilizers to farmers and promotes the balanced use of nutrients to increase agricultural productivity.
 
• Key schemes under DoF include the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system for fertilizer subsidies.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA):**
 
 
• This Ministry is responsible for urban development, planning, and housing policies in India.
 
• Key initiatives under MoHUA include the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY) for affordable housing and the Smart Cities Mission to promote sustainable urban living.
 
• It also oversees projects related to urban sanitation, such as the Swachh Bharat Mission (Urban).

questions.question: According to the 2025 Energy Transition Index, which of the following is a key priority for enhancing energy system flexibility and integrating renewables?

options.text: Modernizing and digitalizing power grids and storage systems
Increasing oil imports for energy security

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Modernizing and digitalizing power grids and storage systems**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Modernizing and digitalizing power grids enhances the efficiency and reliability of energy systems by incorporating advanced technologies like smart grids and energy management systems.
 
• Digitalization allows for real-time monitoring, predictive maintenance, and dynamic energy optimization, enabling seamless integration of renewable energy sources into the grid.
 
• Upgraded storage systems such as battery energy storage solutions (BESS) and pumped hydro storage help balance energy supply and demand fluctuations caused by intermittent renewables like solar and wind power.
 
• The modernization of grids supports decentralized energy generation, empowering local communities to produce and consume renewable energy efficiently.
 
• Such advancements align with global energy transition goals, promoting the shift toward cleaner and sustainable energy systems to combat climate change.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Key findings from the 2025 Energy Transition Index**

 
 
• Top Performers: Sweden, Finland, Denmark, Norway, Switzerland.
 
• India's Performance: Ranked 71st (down from 63rd in 2024).
 
• India's Strengths: Improved energy efficiency, increased investment, better energy access, and emission reductions.
 
• India's Challenges: Need for better grid reliability, rural energy access, and reduced reliance on imported energy.
 
• Overall Trend: Progress in equity and sustainability has accelerated, but energy security remains a challenge, with slower readiness momentum.

questions.question: What is the main goal of the 'Green Credit Programme' launched in 2024?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Encourage eco-restoration through credit incentives**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 'Green Credit Programme' launched in 2024 aims to **incentivize environmental conservation activities**, particularly eco-restoration, through credit-based mechanisms.
 
• It enables individuals, communities, and industries to earn credits by actively participating in activities such as **afforestation, reforestation, sustainable agriculture, and waste management.**
 
• The program is designed to promote the **restoration of degraded ecosystems** and enhance biodiversity while contributing to climate change mitigation.
 
• These credits are tradable and can be monetized, creating a financial incentive for the adoption of sustainable and eco-friendly practices.
 
• The initiative aligns with India’s commitments to global climate goals and its agenda of achieving sustainable development while combating environmental degradation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Renewable Energy Certificates (REC) Scheme: **

 
 
• This scheme is designed to promote renewable energy generation. One REC is equivalent to one MWh of electricity generated from renewable sources and can be traded to help entities meet their renewable purchase obligations (RPO).
 
 
 
• **National Mission for a Green India (GIM):**
 
 
• Launched in 2014, this scheme focuses on afforestation activities in degraded forest areas with community participation to increase forest and tree cover and enhance forest quality.

questions.question: The Global Energy Transition Index 2025 is released by which international organization?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**World Economic Forum**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Global Energy Transition Index** is released by the World Economic Forum (WEF), a Swiss-based international organization committed to improving the state of the world.
 
• This index assesses the energy systems of countries based on factors like environmental sustainability, energy security, and affordability, focusing on their readiness for energy transition.
 
• The index uses a unique framework called the **Energy Transition Readiness Framework**, considering both current performance and enabling conditions for energy transition.
 
• It ranks countries based on their ability to adopt clean energy technologies, reduce carbon emissions, and ensure reliable access to energy.
 
• The WEF works closely with governments, businesses, and other stakeholders to provide actionable insights for achieving sustainable energy transitions globally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **IRENA (International Renewable Energy Agency)**

 
 
• IRENA is an intergovernmental organization that supports countries in their transition to sustainable energy.
 
• It primarily focuses on promoting renewable energy sources like solar, wind, and hydroelectric power.
 
• Its reports and initiatives emphasize renewable energy deployment, innovation, and policy frameworks worldwide.
 
• While IRENA plays a key role in global energy discussions, it does not release the Global Energy Transition Index.
 
 
 
• **IEA (International Energy Agency)**
 
 
• IEA is an autonomous agency established in the framework of the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD).
 
• It focuses on energy security, economic development, and environmental sustainability across member countries.
 
• IEA releases reports like the World Energy Outlook and Energy Technology Perspectives.
 
 
 
• **UNDP (United Nations Development Programme)**
 
 
• UNDP is a global development network under the United Nations, focusing on sustainable development, poverty alleviation, and climate change.
 
• Its energy-related work often involves improving energy access and promoting clean energy solutions in developing countries.
